title: 3 individuals booked at York facilities on June 6
text:
Booking records show that three individuals were processed at centers in York, Pennsylvania, on June 6, 2026.
Two booking entries had charges in the ‘Drug’ category, while one booking was categorized as ‘Other.’
These records reflect charges noted at the time of processing. The individuals mentioned have not been found guilty of any offenses based solely on this information.
